title: ReportVoiceUsage
description: supabase/functions/report-voice-usage/index.ts. The client POSTs the duration of a just-ended realtime voice session so the daily seconds cap (the soft half of the voice throttle, alongside mint-realtime-token's hard session-count cap) accumulates real usage. A client can only under-report (bounded by the hard session cap), so this is trusted for cost-shaping despite being client-reported. Values are clamped server-side to a max of 3600 seconds per report.

seconds.description: Session duration in seconds. Non-finite or <= 0 values are silently treated as 0 (still returns {status:"ok"}, no error). Clamped server-side to 3600 max.
